text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: High error rate on runtime-serving (gpu-prefill) — multiple pods reporting CUDA OOM during prefill, container restarts detected. 8 pods in cluster-gpu-us-west1 are failing prefill step.

maya: paging oncall (maya) — I got the page, digging in now. Any customer-facing impact?

henry: seeing repeated `CUDA out of memory` in pod logs. stack shows failure in prefill_buffer() and then kubelet killed container. sample log:```runtime | ERROR RuntimeEngine - CUDA out of memory when allocating 1.2GiB for KV cache during prefill```

sam: logs show long single-request prefill with seq_len ~ 112k tokens coming from a single customer stream. batching=1 but prefill tries to materialize full KV.

maya: ok, immediate mitigation options — 1) apply temporary policy to reject prefill requests > 8k tokens (rate limit via gateway), 2) enable prefill-chunking (server-side) to stream in 4k token windows, 3) fallback to 8-bit quantized model variant for affected pods. Want to coordinate which to do first.

li: I'm for policy + chunking. Policy is fastest (gateway flag). I can flip the gate: `rbac:prefill_max_tokens=8192` on the edge LB.

henry: while that's rolling, i'm going to cordon the worst nodes and drain pods for a quick restart on fresh nodes to stop node-flap churn. Observed node 10.3.2.14 hit repeated oom_killer and then kubelet restarted runtime.

maya: li — please flip the prefill_max_tokens gate now and post the rollout id. Also open temporary incident page that we can share with CS. julie, tagging you for customer comms.

li: flipped gate at rollout-id: rollout_20240315_01. Propagated to all edge instances in ~20s. Patch: `prefill_max_tokens=8192` set.

julie (support): ack. Notifying affected customers (ticket #CS-4122, #CS-4129) and posting a brief note: "We observed transient model runtime errors for very large single-request contexts; temporary request size limit applied while we stabilize."

henry: also enabled prefill-chunking on runtime via hot-config patch (non-disruptive): `PREFILL_CHUNK_SIZE=4096` and `PREFILL_CHUNKING=true`. Applying to daemonset `runtime-gpu` left->right. patch id cfg-3741.

sam: monitoring: error rate dropped 70% in 5 minutes. Still seeing a handful of pods OOM during in-flight requests — plan to rollback heavy customers to small batch sizes or to route to dedicated capacity.

maya: we should also temporarily enable the 8-bit variant for low-priority traffic. henry, can you push variant routing so non-enterprise tier moves to quantized-v8?

henry: routing change live: route-policy `prefill_fallback_quant` active. Non-SLA customers will be routed to `model-x-8bit` if prefill cannot be satisfied.

li: docs: added entry in incidents repo with mitigation steps and the toggles we used.

maya: customer impact summary: 3 enterprise customers experienced increased latency / 429s for large single-request contexts; no data exfiltration, no model corruption. Support tickets opened; CS notified.

julie (support): posted customer messages and queued follow-ups for impacted accounts.

sam: follow-up actions: 1) enforce server-side max prefill size permanently in next release, 2) implement better KV incremental allocation to avoid all-or-nothing prefill, 3) add unit tests for very long contexts, 4) update runbook to include prefill-chunking and routing knobs.

maya: agreed. I'm taking incident lead for postmortem. Creating postmortem doc now and assigning owners: henry -> infra changes, sam -> runtime engine fixes, li -> gateway limits rollout, julie -> customer comms.

incident-bot: Incident channel created: #incident-gpu-prefill-1775000123. Incident severity P2.

maya: closing on-call handoff: i'll stay on until the postmortem draft is ready and metrics return to baseline (error rate < 0.5%). If anyone sees a regression ping immediately.

henry: one more log snippet for the record:```kubectl logs runtime-gpu-7f8 -c runtime --since=10m | tail -n 50
ERROR: CUDA error: out of memory
Stack trace: RuntimeEngine::allocate_kv_cache -> cudalloc -> CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
kubelet: Killing container with id docker://runtime due to OOMKilled
```

maya: thanks all. updating incident timeline and moving to post-incident actions.
